g.text: Sborka: the host gathers the guests, then goes on air

text.tspan: the page asks again every few seconds
guests join with a name and a role
order, who is on screen, mute,
and sends it to the RTMP target
the room is deleted, the broadcast stops
Shared with everyone in the room
A guest's browser reports the host gone;
the server closes the room only if
nobody who may host is still in it

g.text: Only the room's owner can rename someone else
